book.name: Amǝ Ibǝru
book.title: Cautera aban ká aban AMƏ IBƏRU

content: Ace mani ka, wun amǝ'eamrǝarǝu mǝnana Ɓakuli taria ɓǝà duk amale, sǝ à kum tunǝban mǝ'mwashati atà aɓwana male ace ká kùli ka, ɓǝ̀ sǝm nyesǝ ɗenyicau ma'sǝm aban Yesu. Yì nda ɓwa mǝnana Ɓakuli tasǝi ɓǝ̀ yì duk Pǝris Mǝgule mala paɓamuru mǝnana sǝm bangŋǝna ama nda sǝm kpakiyi atè ka.
Yì ka, ndanǝ mǝsǝcau aban Ɓakuli mana twali, kǝla mǝnana Musa ka, ndanǝ mǝsǝcau aɓa túró male aban aɓwana mala Ɓakuli kat ka.
Sǝama Yesu ka, ndanǝ gulo mana kútì mala Musa ka, kǝla mana ɓwa mǝnana ɓak ɓala ka, gulo kútì nggearǝ ɓah ka.
Acemǝnana koya ɓala ka, ɓwa nǝ̀ ɓè, sǝ Ɓakuli ka, nda ɓak koya gìr kat ka.
Musa, kǝla guro aɓalǝ aɓwana mala Ɓakuli kat ka, dum nǝ mǝsǝcau, sǝ bangcau amur agir mǝnana Ɓakuli nǝ̀ yia nea a dǝmba ka.

Sǝ Kǝrǝsti, kǝla muna ka, dum nǝ mǝsǝcau amur aɓwana mala Ɓakuli. Sǝ sǝm ngga, sǝm nda ka amǝno yì aɓwana mala Ɓakuli, ɓǝ̀ sǝm bwal kàngkàng arǝ paɓamuru andǝ tsǝkɓalǝu ma'sǝm mǝnana sǝm nggǝ jali nǝi ka.
Ace mani ka, kǝla mǝnana Bangŋo Mǝfele kǝ na ama:
Wun amǝ'eamrǝarǝu, wu tsǝkir wun, ɓǝà kǝa kum kǝɓwa aɓalǝ wun mǝnana ndanǝ ɓabum mala ɓealɓikea andǝ ɗwanyi earnǝ cau mana nǝ̀ tsǝì nǝ̀ bwakibuì arǝ kpata Ɓakuli mǝyilǝmuì ka ɗang.
Dumǝna ama wun nǝ̀ nggǝ ɓak ɓabum arǝ wun a koya pwari mǝnana à nǝ̀ tunǝi ama <<Yalung>> ngga, ace mǝnana ɓǝ̀ cauɓikea ɓǝ̀ kǝa swarki kǝ̀ ɓwa atà wun, ɓǝ̀ dum nǝ murcandǝa arǝ Ɓakuli ɗang.
Ɓǝ̀ sǝm bwal kàngkàng arǝ gūliarǝu ma'sǝm mana sǝm tinate nǝi sǝ kya bik masǝlǝate ka, gìr mǝnana kat mala Kǝrǝsti na ka, sǝm nǝ̀ kumi atè.
Sǝ à yana mǝnana ɗe à ok gi, sǝ à mgbicau ka? Kǝ aɓwana mǝnana Musa pusǝia aɓa Masar ka, à nda re?
Sǝ arǝ ayan sǝ bum Ɓakuli lúllô, pǝlǝa lumi-ine? Pa arǝ aɓwana mǝnana à pak cauɓikea, yia mǝnana aluia sukkio aɓa pǝɗanban a njenza ka re?
Sǝ nǝ ayan sǝ Ɓakuli kána, ama à pà nǝ̀ kutio aɓa usǝlǝo male raka? Kǝ amǝ mgbikiru mǝno na re?
Nda sǝm yì sǝni ka, à kum kutio ɗang, ace kǝ ɗwanyi paɓamuru malea.
